USD.note: Fed held 3.75-4.00% on 28 Oct with two hike dissents; a December hike is ~76% priced (30 Oct) after a Q3 GDP beat (3.4%). Repricing risk judged balanced.

EUR.note: ECB held 2.50% and pointed to December (75-84% priced). French revenue vote 3 Nov with OAT-Bund at 159bp, wider over 4 weeks; Brent +10.9% hurts.

GBP.note: Budget passed without gilt stress (10Y -2.1bp). A 5 Nov BoE hike to 4.00% is ~95% priced, with Feb/Jul hikes; economists see less after November.

JPY.note: BoJ held 1.25% (8-1) and said underlying inflation is at target; a December hike is only ~57% priced. MoF warned of decisive FX action; Brent +10.9% weighs.

CHF.note: SNB at 0% gives the lowest carry; only qualitative talk of an early-2027 hike. Swiss CPI on 3 Nov (1.3% expected by one source) is the week's test.

CAD.note: BoC hiked to 2.50% but August GDP stalled (0.0% vs +0.2%); a December hike is ~50-57% priced. Brent +10.9% supports; US tariffs weigh.

AUD.note: RBA hike to 4.85% on 3 Nov is ~81% priced (ASX, 31 Oct); Bullock calls inflation far too high. Highest implied carry (~4.91% by May 2027).

NZD.note: RBNZ held 2.75% (4-3) against hike pricing, but all members see tighter policy as likely; a December hike is ~40.8% priced. GDT +3.7% over two auctions.

XAU.note: Gold factor G = 0: real yields -25bp offset by flat breakevens, mixed ETF flows and a neutral risk regime. XAU = G + USD = +2.
